name: Crude Tattoo, Bodily Purity
body:
Aura faint abjuration; CL 3rd; Slot –; Price 2,250 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

These crudely drawn tattoos always depict various symbols tied to health and purity.

EFFECT

Individuals bearing one of these tattoos gain a +1 resistance bonus to any saves related to a corruption’s stain or advancement (Pathfinder Roleplaying Game Horror Adventures). Acquiring multiple of these tattoos increases the overall potency, with each additional crude tattoo of bodily purity increasing the bonus by +1 up to a maximum of +5.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells resistance; Special Profession (calligraphy artist, painter, or tattoo artist) 3 ranks; Cost 1,125 gp
